answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. At dawn 200 slots open: sealed bids, top 200 pay the clearing price, locked 20 epochs, rest refused. A saffron trader pays once for one slot. A forger needing 1,000 identities must pay 50 coins each, 50,000 in total, with idle slots forfeited. Honest agents recover the bid in 6 epochs and earn undiluted rewards; the delta between one honest cost and that total is the protection.
